ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 25% high-intensity (white) to 75% low-intensity (black) across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe exhibits a contiguous white patch on the distal third with internal black mottling; left lobe shows a narrow white border along the distal leading edge; the remainder of the visible surface is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an acute pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; concave trajectory sweep from the distal lobe tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular nodes (barnacles) are localized on the distal tip and along the trailing edge of the right lobe and the apex of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Epibiotic barnacle colonization present as discrete high-intensity nodes along the fluke margins.
